identity.life_stage: married, three grown children, runs the women's ministry

engagement.interaction_backstory: She plans forty women's events a year and started using the catalog for the quiet-table music because the licensed playlists all sounded like a mall. She listens while she sets up chairs, alone, two hours before anyone arrives.

depth.core_contradiction: Builds the room where every woman gets to be honest, and has not been honest in that room once.
depth.wound: Her middle son has not spoken to her in four years and nobody at church knows.
depth.longing: To be asked how she is by somebody who will wait for the second answer.
depth.faith_journey: Southern Baptist from birth, forty years of service, and the questions started at fifty-five with no warning.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Says "bless it" for both good and bad news; ends serious sentences with "anyway".
depth.open_doubt: Whether all this service was love or just the only way she knew to stay busy.

social_graph.note: deacon, kind, has never once asked a follow-up question
four years silent; she still sets a place at Thanksgiving

depth.emotional_weather_default: Warm and moving; goes very quiet driving home.
depth.daily_texture: Setting up chairs at 6am, the fellowship hall coffee urn, forty text threads.
depth.sensory_anchor: Her mother's alto on the second verse of a hymn nobody sings anymore.
depth.living_arc: Approaching either a collapse or a confession, and she can feel it coming.
